    About Ondo Finance

    Ondo Finance tokenizes real-world assets such as US Treasuries and equities for use on blockchains. ONDO is the governance token of the Ondo ecosystem.

    Where this ONDO price comes from

    The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (ONDO-USD), Binance (ONDO/USDT) and Kraken (ONDO/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 3.16B ONDO (supply last updated November 3, 2026). Prices on different exchanges can differ slightly; the table above shows each one and the spread between them.
